indications: FLYRCADO is indicated for positron emission tomography (PET) myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) under rest or stress (pharmacologic or exercise) in adult patients with known or suspected coronary artery disease (CAD) to evaluate for myocardial ischemia and infarction.
contraindications: Administer FLYRCADO via intravenous injection. ( 2.2 ) When rest and stress imaging are conducted on the same day, the recommended administered activities are ( 2.2 ): Rest imaging: 93 MBq to 111 MBq (2.5 mCi to 3 mCi) Pharmacologic stress imaging: 222 MBq to 241 MBq (6 mCi to 6.5 mCi) Exercise stress imaging: 333 MBq to 352 MBq (9 mCi to 9.5 mCi) When rest and stress imaging are conducted over two days, the recommended rest and stress administered activities, for both pharmacologic and exercise stress, are 93 MBq to 111 MBq (2.5 mCi to 3 mCi). ( 2.2 ) See full prescribing information for radiation safety, preparation, administration, imaging, and radiation dosimetry information. ( 2.1 , 2.2 , 2.3 , 2.4 )
name: Flyrcado
